roles.deleteConfirmInUse_other: Delete the role “{{name}}”? {{count}} members will lose everything it grants.

plugins.descriptionPlaceholder: What this instance is for (e.g. "Company news blog")

tags.placeholder: Type a tag and press Enter

customFields.title: Custom fields
customFields.empty: This instance defines no custom fields yet — add them in the plugin's configuration.

content.scheduleHint: Scheduling publishes what is currently in the editor. One schedule per item — setting a new time replaces the old one.

richText.markdownHint: This field stores Markdown source, not HTML, because that is what reads it further down the line. Pasted Markdown is understood, and what you type here is converted back to Markdown when it is saved.

scheduledView.title: Publishing queue
scheduledView.subtitle: Everything waiting to go live, across every collection in this workspace.
scheduledView.emptyHint: Schedule an item from its editor and it appears here until it goes live.

bulk.deleteConfirm_one: Delete {{count}} item? This can’t be undone.
bulk.deleteConfirm_other: Delete {{count}} items? This can’t be undone.

media.deleteManyConfirm_one: Delete {{count}} file? This can’t be undone.
media.deleteManyConfirm_other: Delete {{count}} files? This can’t be undone.
media.optimizedHint: A smaller optimized copy is served to visitors.

folders.title: Folders
folders.deleteConfirm: Delete folder “{{name}}”? Its files move back to Unfiled.

detail.title: Media detail
detail.name: File name
detail.processing: Optimized versions are still being generated…
detail.noVariants: No optimized versions for this file type.
detail.versionsHint: Visitors are automatically served the smallest suitable version.

tour.railBody: Filter the library, or drag files onto a folder to move them there. Unfiled takes them back out.
tour.uploadBody: Drop files here or click to browse. They upload one at a time so each progress bar means something.
tour.gridBody: Drag one onto a folder to move it. Select several first and the whole selection moves together.
tour.usageBody: What the library holds, split between originals and the optimised versions generated for the web.

forms.title: Form submissions
forms.subtitle: Everything visitors have sent through your forms.
forms.noFormsHint: Install the Forms plugin and declare a form in its configuration; submissions show up here.
forms.noSubmissionsHint: Nothing has been submitted through this form yet.
forms.deleteConfirm: Delete this submission? This cannot be undone.
forms.notifyOffHint: Email notifications are off for this form — turn them on in the Forms plugin configuration.

sites.title: Sites
sites.dropHint: Drag & drop your built website here, or
sites.noIndexWarning: Uploaded, but no index.html was found at the site root.
sites.noDeployments: No deployments yet. Upload your files and publish.
sites.deleteDescription: This permanently deletes the site. It cannot be undone.
sites.deleteConsequenceBuilds: All builds and their published files are deleted.
sites.deleteConsequenceRepo: The site's git repository and its full history are deleted.
sites.deleteConsequenceDomains: Domains pointing here are unlinked and stop serving the site.
sites.deletedPartial: Site deleted, but some stored files could not be removed. Check the logs.

desktopOnly.title: This editor needs a wider screen
desktopOnly.description: The code editor and the visual builder put a file tree, a buffer and a live preview side by side. There is no arrangement of those that works on a phone, so they are desktop tools.

builder.lastPage: A site needs at least one page.
builder.pagePathTaken: A page already uses the path {{path}}.
builder.pagePathHint: Leave empty to build the address from the title. Use /parent/child to nest a page, or a :slug segment for a detail page — one page that shows any single item, e.g. /events/:slug for /events/summer-party.
builder.pageDetailRoute: Detail page: serves every address under it, and the block on it shows whichever item the address names.
builder.noProject: This site has no builder project yet.
builder.generatedFileHint: This file is generated from the theme in site.json. Edit the theme instead — changes here are overwritten on the next save.
builder.emptyPage: This page is empty. Drag a block in to start.
builder.noSettings: This component has no settings of its own.
builder.selectSomething: Select something on the canvas to edit it.
builder.addClass: Add a class and press Enter
builder.contentRefHint: Pick the plugin instance this component reads from.
builder.themeHint: Theme tokens are shared by every page and generate styles/theme.css.
builder.designKitHint: A kit sets the whole look — palette, type scale, corners, shadows. Switching is reversible and never touches your own CSS.
builder.designKitCustom: Your theme has been edited by hand, so it no longer matches a kit. Picking one replaces those values.
builder.refreshBlockStylesConfirm: This replaces styles/global.css with the current block stylesheet. Any edits you made in that file are lost — your page CSS is untouched.
builder.refreshBlockStylesNeedsKit: The newer stylesheet uses {{count}} design tokens your theme does not define, so the “{{kit}}” kit is applied at the same time. Without it the page would lose its type scale, corners and shadows.

ai.title: Generate with AI
ai.applied: Added to your working draft — review it in Source Control.
ai.unusable: The model did not return usable output.
ai.hintBlock: Adds one section to the end of the current page. Nothing else changes.
ai.hintPage: Replaces everything on “{{page}}” — its markup and its styles.
ai.hintSite: Replaces every page, the navigation and the theme. You will see what it wrote before anything is applied.
ai.confirmSiteBody: The generated site has {{pages}} pages and {{styles}} stylesheets. Applying it replaces the pages you have now. Nothing is committed — you can review the whole change in Source Control and discard it.
ai.skippedFiles: Skipped, because a Mode A site does not contain them:

placeholder.block: A pricing section with three tiers — Starter, Team and Enterprise — and a note that prices exclude VAT.
placeholder.page: A contact page: how to reach us, opening hours, and a map placeholder.
placeholder.site: A site for a small architecture studio in Brno: home, projects, about, contact. Calm, lots of whitespace.

regions.title: Layout
regions.empty: No shared regions yet. A region is a band — a header, a footer — that appears on every page using it.
regions.confirmDelete: Delete the region “{{label}}” and its markup?
regions.settingsHint: A region has no page settings of its own — it takes the settings of whichever page shows it.
regions.noLayouts: No layouts yet. A layout decides which regions wrap a page.

components.title: Components
components.empty: No components yet. Build one to lay out your own block and point it at your content.
components.sourceNone: No content — just markup I want to reuse
components.modeDetail: One item, chosen by the page URL
components.label: Name
components.propsHint: Each one becomes a field in the inspector when this component is dropped on a page.
components.confirmDelete: Delete the component “{{label}}”? Pages already using it keep their placeholder.
components.notATemplate: Open one of your components to bind its parts to content.
components.repeatHint: This element is drawn once per item fetched. Everything inside it reads that item.
components.formatMedia: As an image or file URL
components.visibilityHint: Use a field that is only sometimes filled — an image, a subtitle — to drop the element when there is nothing to show.
components.showIf: Only when this has a value
components.hideIf: Hide when this has a value
components.emptyStateHint: Kept only when there are no items at all; removed otherwise.

consent.title: Cookies & consent
consent.hint: This site stores a per-visit id for anonymous analytics. Ask visitors first unless you have established you do not need to.
consent.messageDefault: We use anonymous analytics to understand how this site is used. No data is stored until you accept.
consent.offWarning: No banner is shown and analytics starts on page load. In the EU/UK this usually needs a lawful basis you can point to.

ide.resizeSidebar: Drag to resize the sidebar (double-click to reset)
ide.resizePreview: Drag to resize the preview (double-click to reset)
ide.resetSandboxHint: Clear the preview's test data (form submissions, sign-ups, chats). Live data is untouched.
ide.conflictWarning: Someone else changed these files while you were editing: {{files}}. Reload to get the latest version (your unsaved changes to those files will be lost).

git.title: Git
git.disabled: Git backend is not configured for this deployment.
git.noRepoAccess: You don't have access to clone this repository. Ask an admin to grant you repo access for this site.
git.noGitPassword: No git password set. Click to set a password or add an SSH key in Account settings.
git.noChanges: No changes — your draft matches this branch.
git.branchMoved: This branch changed while you were editing. Reload to get the latest, then re-apply your changes.
git.conflictIntroCommit: These files were changed both here and on {{branch}} while you were editing. Everything else merged automatically — pick which version to keep for these, then the commit continues.
git.restoreConfirm: Restore your working files to {{sha}}? Uncommitted edits on this branch will be replaced.
git.conflictIntro: {{count}} file(s) conflict. Pick which version to keep for each, then complete the merge.
git.upToDate: Release is already up to date.
git.resolveInScm: Resolve the changes in Source Control, then publish.
git.liveBranchMoved: {{author}} committed to {{branch}} — the branch you are editing
git.markersRemain: Conflict markers are still in this file. Remove them to finish the merge.
git.discardConfirm: Discard your changes to {{path}}? This cannot be undone — the edits are not in git.
git.discardUnavailable: {{path}} is too large for its committed version to have been sent, so it cannot be restored from here. Use the git history instead.

deploy.title: Deployments
deploy.empty: No deployments yet. Publish to build and deploy your site.
deploy.liveSucceeded: A deployment finished and is now live

ide.deleteFolderConfirm_other: Delete {{path}} and the {{count}} files inside it?

agent.title: Assistant
agent.modeHint: Auto applies edits automatically; Manual asks first
agent.empty: Ask Claude to build or change your site. It edits your files live.

starter.starterDesc: A ready-to-run React site wired to your content API, plus the spec.

ide.refreshGeneratedHint: Re-generate the DCMS-owned files — openapi.json, the typed client in src/api/, and the analytics + cookie-consent layer in src/dcms/ — from this workspace’s current plugins. Your own files are not touched.
ide.generatedUpToDate: Generated files are already up to date
ide.branchMovedWarning: Someone else committed to {{branch}} while you were editing. Reload to build on their work (your unsaved changes will be lost).

openapi.title: API documentation

ai.title: AI settings

account.title: Account settings
account.subtitle: Manage your profile and git access credentials.
account.gitUsernameHint: Use this username (or your email) with your password when cloning over HTTPS.
account.changePasswordHint: Change the password you use for git and sign-in. It stays in sync with the git server.
account.setPasswordHint: You signed in with Google and have no password yet. Set one to clone over HTTPS, or add an SSH key below.
account.sshKeysHint: Add an SSH public key to clone/push over SSH without a password.
account.gitAccessHint: Clone with your email or git username + password over HTTPS, or use an SSH key. You can only access repositories you've been granted.
account.deleteHint: Permanently delete your DCMS login and your git account. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteBlocked: You are the only owner of these workspaces:
account.deleteBlockedHint: Transfer each of them to another member, or delete them, then come back here.
account.deleteLeaves: You will leave {{count}} workspaces. Other members keep their access.
account.deleteDescription: This deletes your login and your git account, and removes you from every workspace.
account.deleteConsequenceLogin: Your sign-in, password and SSH keys are deleted.
account.deleteConsequenceGit: Your git account is deleted; you lose access to every repository.
account.deleteConsequenceWorkspaces: You are removed from {{count}} workspaces. Their content is not deleted.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.noneYet: No analytics recorded yet. Enable the Analytics plugin on a site and traffic will appear here.
analytics.directOnly: All traffic arrived directly, with no referrer.
analytics.noCountryData: No country data. Countries are read from the edge (CF-IPCountry by default); see docs/runbook.md.
analytics.clearDescription: This permanently deletes this workspace’s analytics history. It cannot be undone.
analytics.clearConsequenceRollups: All daily totals are deleted; charts start from empty.
analytics.clearConsequenceIrreversible: There is no backup of analytics data.
analytics.visitorsHint: Distinct visitors, counted by a rotating hash. The same person on two devices counts twice; the same device across the period counts once.
analytics.sessionsHint: A run of activity from one visitor. A new session starts after a gap of inactivity.
analytics.pageviewsHint: Page views only — the subset of events with type "pageview".
analytics.eventsHint: Everything recorded, including page views, outbound clicks, downloads and page-leave signals.

chat.title: Chat
chat.botHandlingHint: The AI assistant is answering this visitor.
chat.youHandlingHint: You've taken over — the assistant has stopped replying.
chat.takeoverHint: Reply to take over from the assistant.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.

workspace.slugFixed: Identifier {{slug}} cannot be changed — it is used in URLs, the git organisation and stored file paths.
workspace.transferHint: Hand this workspace to another member. They become the sole owner and you lose the Owner role.
workspace.transferNoCandidates: Invite someone else to this workspace first.
workspace.transferConfirm: Make {{email}} the owner of this workspace? You will lose the Owner role.
workspace.deleteHint: Permanently delete this workspace and everything in it.

workspace.deleteConsequenceSites: {{count}} sites, their builds, published files and git repositories are deleted.
workspace.deleteConsequenceContent: {{content}} content items and {{media}} media files are deleted.

workspace.deleteConsequenceDomains: {{count}} domains are released and stop serving.
workspace.deletedPartial: Workspace deleted, but some stored files could not be removed. Check the logs.

storage.notice: This admin app stores only what it needs to work: your sign-in session, the selected workspace, and interface preferences such as theme and open editor tabs. Nothing is used for advertising or shared with third parties.

audit.loadFailedForbidden: You do not have permission to read this workspace's audit log.
audit.ipReportedHint: Reported by the caller. Not independently verified.

record.platformScopeHint: An account-level event. It belongs to the person, not to this workspace, so it is shown with less detail.

history.emptyHint: Changes to this item will appear here.
